description: This file defines a SwiftUI view named HomeToolbar and its related subviews, implementing a customizable toolbar with buttons and status indicators for the home screen of an iOS application.

classes.name: HomeToolbarStatusButton
classes.description: A subview representing the status indicator button with a pulsing animation for connection status.

classes.name: HomeToolbarActionButton
classes.description: A reusable button view used for actions like chat, settings, and toggles, styled with rounded rectangle backgrounds and dynamic tinting.

methods.name: updatePulse
methods.description: Updates the pulsing animation state based on the gateway connection status, scene phase, and reduce motion setting.

methods.name: accessibilityValue
methods.description: Provides descriptive accessibility label combining gateway and activity states.
